sessionEvents.scope: Session identity and lock/unlock events; no account fields exported

postUserDesktopSetting.changedBy: user confirmed unchecking resume-logon and Apply

conclusions: The eight-slot batch mechanism is bounded and preserves all measured frames, submissions and engine retirement callbacks.
All four B8 captures spend almost all measured frames in P0/1607 MHz core/4006 MHz memory, with no original main/output threshold exceedances.
This is a promising mechanism observation, not proof of a fix: measurements last 12.2-12.6 s versus 65.5-66.8 s for S8.
Two session locks and two unlocks occurred; five GPU measurements are wholly locked, one crosses a lock, and A0/B8 round 1 CPU preparation crosses an unlock.
Raw completion remains diagnostic-complete, but independent unlocked-desktop eligibility is rejected by this additional audit. No frames were removed or rerun.
A read-only preflight and lock-event checks were added in a separate checked launcher; original producer and test evidence remain unchanged.
limits: Clock telemetry is received every 200 ms and is not per-draw frequency measurement.
Foreign GPU overlap is attributed to whole completion batches, not individual member frames.
No observed packet overlap does not exclude all internal driver scheduling or paging mechanisms.
The batch-wait and per-frame-wait medians refer to different populations and must not be divided or compared as one metric.
No new baseline or production timing protocol was promoted; the 5% budget and stability thresholds remain unchanged.
